info.title: Create Merchant API
info.description: API to create a new merchant in the PayU system.

post.description: This API allows you to create a new merchant in the PayU system.

[merchant][display_name].description: The display name of the merchant that will be shown on PayU dashboard and reports.

merchant[email].description: Primary email address of the merchant for communication and notifications.

merchant[mobile].description: Primary mobile number of the merchant for communication and notifications.

merchant[business_details][pan].description: Permanent Account Number (PAN) of the merchant business.

merchant[business_details][business_enti.description: Type of business entity (e.g., 'Sole Proprietorship', 'Partnership', 'Private Limited').

merchant[product].description: The PayU product that the merchant wants to use (e.g., 'PayUbiz', 'PayUmoney').

merchant[bank_details][account_no].description: Bank account number of the merchant for settlements.

merchant[bank_details][account_holder_na.description: Name of the account holder as per bank records.

merchant[bank_details][ifsc_code].description: IFSC code of the bank branch for settlements.

merchant[business_details][registered_na.description: The registered legal name of the merchant business.

merchant[business_details][business_cate.description: The primary business category of the merchant.

merchant[business_details][business_sub_.description: A more specific subcategory related to the business.

merchant[monthly_expected_volume].description: The monthly expected transaction volume in monetary terms.

merchant[signing_authority_details][name.description: Name of the authorized representative or signing authority for the merchant's business.

merchant[signing_authority_details][panc.description: PAN card number of the signing authority. Note: merchant[signing_authority_details][pancard_name] is required if you post the PAN card number.

merchant[signing_authority_details][emai.description: Email of the authorized representative or signing authority.

merchant[business_details][pancard_name].description: The name as it appears on the PAN card.

merchant[integration_type].description: Specifies the type of integration for the merchant's account.

merchant[gst_number].description: The GST number of the merchant business.

merchant[udyam_number].description: Udyam Registration Number for MSMEs (Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises).

merchant[gst_consent].description: Consent for GST verification and processing.
